display.purpose: Roman serif, Regular only. Titles only: the hero line, section headings, app page titles, the reader's chapter title. Never body, buttons, labels, controls or data.

body.purpose: The warm grotesk that runs the whole tool: UI copy (text-sm), titles (500), labels (text-xs 500).

edition.purpose: Only on the drawn book surfaces (the output tablets). The edition's voice, not the tool's.

shadows.name: flow-card-lift
shadows.purpose: The flow card only (search, review, done). Ambient, no offset. Dark: 0 0 40px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.3).

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Tooltips, select popups, dialogs. Everything else is flat at rest.

motion.name: ease-out-quint
motion.purpose: The house curve: every transition and the flow-card morph (300ms group, 220ms cross-fade).

motion.name: reduced
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion alternative for every animation; the rain draws one still frame.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The committing action (Search, Compile, Download EPUB). Gold fill, ink text, both modes.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Lower-emphasis actions (Preview, Connect). Secondary fill, ink text.

components.name: Content Tag
components.description: Review rows lead with what was retrieved (Transcript, Raw captions, Web text). Secondary pill.

components.name: Paid-path Badge
components.description: The one cue that a step costs money: gold wash, deep-gold text, coin icon.

components.name: Card
components.description: The container. Card ground a step above the page, 1px hairline, never nested.
components.html:
How it works

Any mix of sources, one compilation, two formats.

narrative.overview: One precious metal on a quiet ground. Near-neutral grounds (a warm off-white by day, a chroma-0 near-black by night) carry one strong color, desert gold, the brand's action color. A serif display voice (Prociono) over a warm grotesk (Host Grotesk). The landing's expressive layer lives in a few signatures: the hieroglyph rain, the rotating gold frame, the stone tablets, the grain. Everything else is shadcn/base-ui on one role-named token layer. Derived from shipped code on 2026-09-23; the identity is due for a review.
keyCharacteristics: One brand color, desert gold, on primary actions, focus, active, the mark.
Near-neutral grounds: warm off-white (light), chroma-0 near-black (dark).
Prociono for titles, Host Grotesk for the work, Literata only on drawn books.
Flat surfaces; one ambient lift on the flow card.
Role-named tokens (shadcn convention); no raw values in components.

rules.name: The One Color Rule
rules.body: Desert gold is the only brand hue. The four status colors are data, not decoration. No second accent.

rules.name: The Quiet Ground Rule
rules.body: Grounds stay near-neutral: a faint pull toward the gold's hue on light (chroma <= 0.018), chroma 0 on dark. The one visible tint is the light hero ground.

rules.name: The Gold-Holds-Ink Rule
rules.body: Text on a gold fill is always the ink. Gold as text on a neutral uses primary-strong, never the fill gold.

rules.name: The Display Restraint Rule
rules.body: Prociono sets titles only (hero, section headings, page titles, a chapter title). Never body, buttons, labels, controls or data; Regular weight only.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: A resting shadow is allowed only on the flow card and the stone tablets. Everything else is flat until it floats.

dos: Do use role tokens through their utilities; add a role token or extend a scale before hard-coding a value.
Do make desert gold the one brand color: primary CTAs, focus, active, the mark.
Do use primary-strong for gold text or icons on a neutral surface.
Do keep the ink on every gold fill, and body and placeholder text >= 4.5:1.
Do ship a reduced-motion alternative for every animation.
donts: Don't build a cold enterprise dashboard or a generic AI SaaS page.
Don't wear the costume: no papyrus, sepia or parchment; the hieroglyph rain is the one earned motif.
Don't introduce a second brand color, or use gold where a status belongs.
Don't put white text on gold, or the fill gold as text on the light page.
Don't fork the shadcn primitives' internals to restyle them; change tokens.
Don't add resting shadows, side-stripe borders, or a tracked eyebrow above every section.
